Package growthbook.sdk.java.multiusermode.internal

Class RemoteEvalCoordinator

java.lang.Object
growthbook.sdk.java.multiusermode.internal.RemoteEvalCoordinator
public final class RemoteEvalCoordinator extends Object
INTERNAL: not part of the supported API. Public only because GrowthBookClient lives in the parent package — treat its signatures as free to change without a major version bump. Keeps remote-evaluation fetching, caching, SSE-based cache invalidation, and per-user evaluation context creation outside of the public facade.

This is the remote-eval counterpart to GlobalContextManager/ FeatureRepositoryProvider: the GrowthBookClient facade delegates to it instead of carrying remote-eval-specific state and control flow itself.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Releases the service, cache, and SSE invalidation resources owned by this coordinator.

      Synchronized on the same monitor as getService(), getCache(), and ensureReady() so teardown cannot interleave with lazy creation. In-flight callers already holding a reference are unaffected: RemoteEvalCache.get reports a closed cache as a FeatureFetchException, which callers handle as a fallback.
